plain: Full of shame or scorn; abusive.

webster.text: Reproachful and contemptuous; scurrilous; as opprobrious language; opprobrious words or terms.

example.quote: He represents the legislature in a very opprobrious light.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. JOSEPH M'DOWALL, July 26, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
